items.title: Looking at how the PDF exporter resolves images before touching tests.
items.body: Looking at how the PDF exporter resolves images before touching tests. The grooming summary points at fetchAsset returning null for data URIs.

items.title: rg -n "fetchAsset" src/export
sed -n 1,60p src/export/assets.ts
The resolver returns null for data URIs.
items.body:
The resolver returns `null` for data URIs and swallows network errors, so the PDF exporter silently drops those images.

Plan:
1. Decode `data:` URIs in `fetchAsset`.
2. Resolve relative paths against the document directory.
3. Add tests for data-URI, relative and remote images.

items.title: The test fixture server is not started in the PDF suite.
Command timed out after 600s: yarn vitest run src/export --no-threads
I could not get the PDF image tests to pass.
items.body: I could not get the PDF image tests to pass. Data-URI decoding works in unit tests, but the PDF renderer runs in a worker that has no access to the fixture server. This needs a decision on whether to inline assets before handing the document to the worker.
